item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Current dexterous grasp planners primarily optimize for physical stability, focusing on whether an object can be grasped rather than how it should be grasped to support downstream functional tasks. However, conditioning grasp synthesis on specific human grasp taxonomies typically requires prohibitively expensive, object-annotated datasets. To address these limitations, we propose CoToGrasp, a...

WHY IT MATTERS

CoToGrasp introduces an object-agnostic, contact-topology-conditioned framework for dexterous robotic grasping that enables zero-shot generalization, though it represents an incremental advance in embodied AI manipulation rather than a paradigm shift.
